verdicts: PASS — an oblique aerial of this street grid and these footprints, no map interface
FAIL — a generic city, streets that are not in the tile, or labels and UI left in

runs.title: INTERIOR branch. Does it furnish what is modelled — and only that?
verdicts: PASS — same room and camera; the modelled sofas, shelving, TV and plants, rendered; nothing added
FAIL — added rugs, art or decor, moved or redesigned furniture, or a changed camera
runs.note: output not committed: derived from a test-only guide fixture

runs.title: The artwork in the second image, hung in the room. THAT painting, at a real size?
verdicts: PASS — the same mountain painting, flat on a wall, believable size, room otherwise unchanged
FAIL — a different painting, wrong perspective or scale, or the room altered
runs.note: output not committed: derived from a test-only guide fixture

runs.title: Massing + a reference with a DIFFERENT form. Whose building comes back?
verdicts: PASS — the courtyard block, every volume and step intact, clad and lit like the reference
FAIL — the reference house comes back, or the massing changed shape, or it is still a model on a table

runs.title: FIX CHECK — camera and doors named, frame pinned to the massing. Whose building now?
verdicts: PASS — the courtyard block from the same high angle, same 3:2 frame, clad and lit like the reference, no garage door
FAIL — the camera drops again, the reference house’s doors return, or the frame is not 3:2

runs.title: FIX CHECK — the frame pinned to the room. Portrait in, portrait out?
verdicts: PASS — the same painting on the wall, the room in its own 9:16 portrait frame, camera unchanged
FAIL — a square or landscape frame again, or a different painting
